verdict.rationale: Omnara is documented as an orchestration/monitoring layer that launches and interacts with agents (via YAML config, CLI/API/SDK, MCP tools, subagents) but no evidence describes an agent completing a requested feature end-to-end or writing tests — the docs focus on connectivity, approvals, and session persistence, not on autonomous implementation outcomes. Community threads discuss UI, pricing, and remote access, not code/test quality delivered by the agent.
